content_sections.heading: RGU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NO.ET/GF-360/Agri.Ext/2022(Vol-I) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RGU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in Agricultural Extension/Extension Education with a minimum of 55% mark (or equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) from an accredited Indian/Foreign University. Candidates must have cleared the ICAR-National Eligibility Test (NET)/equivalent NET. Candidates who have been awarded Ph.D. shall be exempted from the requirement of ICAR- National Eligibility Test (NET)/equivalent NET. Desirable: Candidates with Ph.D./NET and teaching experience shall be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary for one (1) semester; services may be extended if required by the University.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data stating qualifications, experience, specialization, etc. Original academic documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the interview on the date and time mentioned along with bio-data stating qualifications, experience, specialization, etc. Bring original supporting documents. Attend on 2 November 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. In case of circumstances due to natural calamity, bandh called, etc. on the date of the interview, the same shall be conducted on the next working day.
